subject: Re: MAP milestone - data handling & compliance (retention, logging, PHI/PII)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finex.com>, Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@finex.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (data handling milestone)

Hi Sarah / Aaron 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our call, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the data handling & compliance milestone we discussed. High level: retention policy alignment, logging/audit trail requirements, and PHI/PII processing constraints.

Key asks for you:
- Confirm which categories of data you consider sensitive / PHI (examples: cardholder name + transactional notes flagged as medical claim).
- Confirm the maximum retention window for logs and model inputs (Finex target was 90 days, please confirm).
- Any required audit log formats or SIEM ingestion endpoints?

Attached: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.docx (MAP with milestone table) and MAP_data_handling_matrix.xlsx (detailed mapping of data flows, retention, and controls).

Proposed milestone in the MAP (for your review):
- Milestone: Data handling & compliance sign-off
  - Owner: Finex (security) + Redwood (solutions/legal)
  - Target close date: 2026-11-12
  - Dependencies: access to sample logs; completion of SOC 2 evidence packet; decisions on PII redaction approach

Next steps:
1) You review the attached MAP and matrix and mark any gaps by EOD Tuesday (11/02).
2) We'll loop in our infra lead (Aditya) and engineer (Dev) for any technical feasibility notes.
3) Quick 30-min follow-up next week to finalize target close date.

Thanks  happy to adjust timelines based on your procurement/regulatory cadence.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.docx (20KB)
Attachment: MAP_data_handling_matrix.xlsx (12KB)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@finex.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (data handling milestone)

Hi Marissa 

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. A few clarifications from our side:
- PHI scope: we are not a healthcare provider, but we do process some claim-related notes that could be considered sensitive. I'll pull a short list for you.
- Retention: our current policy is 180 days for transaction logs, but security would prefer 90 days if possible. Is that feasible on your side?
- Audit logs: we ingest logs into Splunk; an RFC for a syslog/s3 export would help.

We can review the MAP internally and aim to get comments by 11/02. Would like to schedule the follow-up on 11/04 or 11/05 (PST).

Also tagging Aaron since he owns integrations  Aaron, are there any SIEM constraints we should flag?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Security Manager, Finex Payments
Sarah.Jenkins@finex.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finex.com>, Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@finex.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (data handling milestone)

Sarah / Aaron 

Appreciate the quick response and helpful context. Looping in Aditya (Infra / Security) and Dev (Solutions Engineer) to confirm feasibility on our end and to capture any additional requirements for SIEM ingestion.

Aditya / Dev  summary of Finex asks:
- Target retention: Finex prefers 90 days (currently 180). Can Redwood support redaction/short TTL for model inputs and logs to hit 90 days?
- SIEM: they prefer Splunk ingestion via S3 or syslog; they may also want a structured audit export for compliance audits.
- PHI/PII: they will provide a short list of sensitive fields; ask is whether we can configure model-level PII redaction + log filtering.

Could you please:
1) Confirm technical feasibility and any constraints (esp. for 90-day TTL on logs vs model KV cache).
2) Note any required actions from Finex (sample logs, IP allowlist, KMS key exchange).
3) Update the attached MAP and return a v2 by EOD 11/03 so Sarah can review before the follow-up.

Thanks team 
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft-v1.docx (updated request: please produce v2)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finex.com>, Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@finex.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (data handling milestone)

Hi all 

Quick feasibility notes from infra/security:
- 90-day retention: supported. We can implement a 90-day TTL for logs and model input storage per customer. Note: for real-time inference, KV cache is ephemeral (per-session) and not long-lived; we do persist logs and traces which we can TTL to 90 days.
- SIEM ingestion: we support S3 export and syslog push to customer endpoints. For Splunk specifically, an S3-to-HTTP ingestion or Splunk forwarder works; we'll provide a sample manifest.
- PII/PHI redaction: we offer a configurable preprocessor that can perform token-level redaction or replacement on inputs before they hit the model. Two options: client-side redaction (preferred for max privacy) or server-side preprocessor with strict access controls and audit logs.

Actions / open items for Finex:
- Provide sample logs (anonymized) and the list of fields you deem PHI/PII.
- Provide target SIEM endpoint (S3 bucket or syslog endpoint) and any network allowlist IPs.
- Confirm whether client-side redaction is required or if server-side is acceptable (we'll default to server-side with HSM/KMS-controlled keys unless you request client-side).

I've updated the MAP (attached as Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.docx) and a short technical appendix (MAP_data_handling_matrix.xlsx) with the options and owner's actions highlighted. Proposed updated milestone dates: target close 2026-11-15 (adds one week for sampling/proof). If Finex needs 11/12, we can try to accelerate but will need sample logs by 11/04.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.docx (22KB)
Attachment: MAP_data_handling_matrix.xlsx (updated 15KB)

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@finex.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (data handling milestone)

Marissa / Aditya / Dev 

Thanks  this is helpful. A few confirmations from Finex:
- We'll provide the anonymized sample logs and PHI/PII field list by COB 11/04. (Sarah)
- We are okay with server-side redaction provided there are audit logs and KMS controls. We will note client-side redaction as preferred for certain data classes but not mandatory at launch. (Security)
- Splunk ingest via S3 is fine. I'll send the S3 bucket details and IAM role next. (Integrations / Aaron)

We can accept the updated target close date of 2026-11-15 if Redwood needs the extra week. Please mark Owners: Finex Security (Sarah), Redwood Infra (Aditya), Redwood Solutions (Dev), and Redwood AE (Marissa).

Let's confirm a 30-min sync on 11/10 to review sample logs and the technical appendix.

Appreciate the quick turnaround  looking forward to the MAP v2.

Regards,
Sarah
Sr. Security Manager, Finex Payments
